title: A Person at the Controls: The Speed They Can Drive at When They See the Past, the Dead Man's Timeout, and a Vehicle That Slows Itself for the Wall

artifact.note: teleoperation of a ground vehicle: the speed at which a vehicle can still stop within what an operator can see, given the video delay, their reaction and the command delay; a governor that ramps the commanded speed within acceleration and braking limits, drops to a stop when no command has arrived within a timeout, and caps the speed so the vehicle can stop short of an obstacle that its own sensor sees, whatever the operator asks
